connector.name: LQWD Gateway
connector.registryDescription: Free Lightning faucet MCP - agents register, get an inbound channel, bootstrap an LDK node.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.lqwdclaw.bot over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the lqwdtech account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <api_key>. Obtain via the lqwd_register tool (the only auth-free tool); the returned api_key has the form `lqwd_<random>` and is used on all subsequent MCP requests.
